findings.detail: The repeated head selection was run twice at eda26ca8: /tmp/wide-head-3-g9NM produced '53 failed, 3128 passed, 5 skipped, 9 warnings, 408 errors' (suite-head.log, 461 ids in head-ids.txt), and /tmp/wide-head2-3-zsp0 produced the recorded 67-id arm (suite-head2.log). The manifest's retry_failures should have recorded the discarded arm's ids or its 'scaffolding:' attribution so the record reconciles with the logs on disk.
findings.summary: retry_failures is recorded as none while a leftover suite-head.log and head-ids.txt show an earlier head arm at the same revision eda26ca8 that produced 53 failed/408 errors and 461 ids before the recorded head2 arm replaced it; a reader comparing after_suite against the run directory finds an arm the manifest neither names nor attributes.

findings_note: one non-blocking finding recorded under findings

item_verdicts.call_sites: Three production call sites resolve the moved names: preparation.py:648 and :1897 call them in dispatch, and reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2211 imports _measurement_flag_refusal from preparation, and preparation re-exports it by importing it at preparation.py:77.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit: one commit (eda26ca8) moves MEASURE_ONLY_FLAG, MEASUREMENT_LANDING_ROLES, _section_declaration, _measurement_flag_refusal and _mark_measurement_run out of preparation.py unchanged into measurement.py, and adds one import line to preparation.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks that test_every_concern_fits_the_module_limit pass and that the wide dispatch/review/queue/plan selection show no head-only failure id; the manifest records both arms with literal commands and logs, and I verified the delta from the run's own id files.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to move a coherent part of reckon/crew/dispatching/preparation.py into a new module so every module in the package is within the 2000-line limit, keeping the surface tests/test_dispatch_split_keeps_its_surface.py checks; the landed commit does exactly that at reckon/crew/dispatching/measurement.py:1-120.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete, commits eda26ca82855ab14c5a01ac9b5aa4db97403301c, changed_paths naming the two modules, baseline_suite 68 failure ids and after_suite 67 ids each with its log path, and an artifacts line quoting both EXIT=1 arms.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared scope is the reckon/crew/dispatching directory plus evidence/figures fragments; the diff touches only reckon/crew/dispatching/measurement.py (new) and reckon/crew/dispatching/preparation.py, both inside it.

justifications.durability: tests/test_dispatch_split_keeps_its_surface.py:660 reddens if either module exceeds 2000 lines, and tests/test_a_measurement_run_never_lands.py:574 refuses a done section dispatched without the flag, so re-inlining or breaking the moved guard is caught; the identity-preservation claim in the manifest is not itself asserted.
justifications.evidence: The manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite name the literal wide command and their logs end in EXIT=1; comm over the run's base-ids/head2-ids files reports the module-limit test as the only base-only id and zero head-only ids.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatching/measurement.py:1 follows the package idiom of a module docstring plus from ._imports, mirrors fences.py:27's _FACADE_BINDINGS declaration, and introduces no plan label, version suffix or attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatching/preparation.py falls from 2011 to 1898 lines and reckon/crew/dispatching/measurement.py is 120, so every module in the package is within the limit the goal names.
justifications.reuse: No owner for the measurement-run dispatch guard exists: reckon/crew/drain_measure.py and landing_measure.py measure drains and landing jobs, and the moved _section_declaration still calls the repository's reckon._store.read_plan and reckon.ledger.normalize_section rather than re-deriving them.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every changed line is one of the two files under reckon/crew/dispatching/ with no test, plan or config edit, so the diff carries nothing the goal does not imply.
